moments.title: Mark Knopfler turns 77
moments.blurb: The legendary Dire Straits frontman and acclaimed solo artist Mark Knopfler celebrates his 77th birthday on August 12th.

angles.name: Dire Straits icon
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the guitar legend Mark Knopfler! From Dire Straits classics to his incredible solo work, what's your favourite track?

angles.name: Guitar hero
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 77th Birthday to Mark Knopfler! His unique fingerstyle guitar has inspired generations. What's the Dire Straits song that first got you hooked?

moments.title: Joe Jonas turns 37
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Joe Jonas, known for the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, will celebrate his 37th birthday on August 15th.

angles.name: Jonas Brother's birthday
angles.copy: It's Joe Jonas's 37th Birthday on Thursday! From Camp Rock to the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, what's your favourite Joe moment?

angles.name: DNCE vibes
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to Joe Jonas, turning 37 this week! Still getting 'Cake By The Ocean' vibes every time. What's your go-to Jonas Brothers or DNCE hit?

moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning British-Albanian singer-songwriter Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: Pop superstar birthday
angles.copy: Dua Lipa turns 31 this week! Which of her massive hits gets you on the dancefloor every time?

angles.name: Future Nostalgia Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa! From 'New Rules' to 'Radical Optimism', she keeps delivering the bops.

moments.title: Cerys Matthews is 57
moments.blurb: Welsh singer-songwriter and broadcaster Cerys Matthews, known for Catatonia, celebrates her 57th birthday today, August 10th.

angles.name: Welsh icon birthday
angles.copy: Penblwydd Hapus to the incredible Cerys Matthews, celebrating her 57th birthday today! What's your favourite Catatonia classic?

angles.name: Catatonia memories
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the one and only Cerys Matthews! A true Welsh music legend. What's the Catatonia track that brings back the best 90s memories?
